 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if not ones or not twos:
        return out
    r, c = ones[0]
    tr, tc = twos[0]
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1 if tr < r else 0
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1 if tc < c else 0
    # Continue along the diagonal while both coordinates have more than one step
    # remaining; then proceed along the longer axis, leaving the final diagonal gap.
    while abs(tr-r) > 1 and abs(tc-c) > 1:
        r += dr; c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr-r) > 1:
        r += dr
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tc-c) > 1:
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
